feeds.title: Escape Mocktails
feeds.description: Escape Mocktails provides a large selection of premium non-alcoholic spirits, alcohol-free spirits, alcohol alternative cocktails, mocktails, and booze-free liquors. We have delicious healthy mocktails and spirits for you to enjoy.

feeds.title: A Beautiful Mess » Drinks
feeds.description: A Beautiful Mess is a blog by Elsie and Emma that features home decor projects, recipes, and crafts, natural beauty, and lots of random bits of their life.

feeds.title: The Mindful Mocktail
feeds.description: It can be tricky to find alcohol alternatives that are healthy and delicious. I bring you nutritional mocktail recipes and inspiration so you can still have fun, enjoy the celebration, and bounce out of bed the next day, feeling fresh and energized. I also provide sober inspiration and blog about living life alcohol free.

feeds.title: This Worthey Life » Virgin Drinks
feeds.description: This Worthey Life inspires everyone to live a 'worthy' life by sharing our passion through food, travel, entertainment, and life adventures. This blog shares our latest Recipes, Frugal Tips, Table Decor Ideas & Life.

feeds.title: The Little Epicurean » Mocktails
feeds.description: The Little Epicurean is the Los Angeles based recipe blog featuring from-scratch baking, decadent desserts, and unique cocktails and mocktails. A recipe collection of mocktails and other non-alcoholic drinks featuring a variety of flavor pairings including fruit juices, teas, and spices.

feeds.title: Living Sober » Drink of the Week
feeds.description: A community website designed to support people who wish to free themselves from the clutches of alcohol. Alcohol has no power to make any occasion more or less special. Here are some beautiful mocktail recipes to keep you inspired.
